endorsements.quote: Consequently, this allows NLP and AI to enhance interoperable patient safety.

unlisted_practices: Develop a standards-based enterprise architecture blueprint for patient safety in health organizations.
Develop a comprehensive, consolidated patient safety ontology and common data model for recording patient safety events.
Establish an open, collaborative platform where contributors can expand a shared patient safety data framework.
Involve patients in safety detection and feedback.
Investigate offline, non-cloud LLMs to prevent leaks of sensitive patient data.
Explore bias detection and mitigation techniques such as error analysis, fairness-aware learning and retrieval-augmented generation for LLMs in patient safety.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/framework paper outlining a visionary, standards-based enterprise architecture and ontology approach to enhance patient safety in the era of generative AI.
